audited.checked_answer:
[Audited trial](https://doi.org/10.1000/mag-audited) was audited in full.

In acute kidney injury, the kidneys clear magnesium more slowly than usual. Checking magnesium every day is reasonable while kidney function is falling. Magnesium rose in a minority of patients during the first week. High magnesium was uncommon without magnesium-containing drugs.

I did not search firsthand reports or community discussions for this answer: Synthetic fixture isolates the closing comparison.

How each study was read: full text read, methods audited by AskRigor.
